children.help: this button also has an action to zoom the window
Display Mode, Display Mode pop-up menu. Switch the ruler display between bars and beats, or hours, minutes, and seconds, or a combination of both. You can also open giant displays.
Playhead Position (Bars), Playhead Position display. Indicates the playhead position in bars and beats. Drag each element vertically to edit it, or double-click and enter a new value.
Tempo, Tempo display. Indicates the playback or recording speed. Drag vertically to speed up or slow down the tempo, or double-click and enter a new value.

Project Tempo menu, Project Tempo pop-up menu. Choose whether the project tempo is maintained, adapts to the tempo of audio recordings and imported audio files, or if Logic Pro determines the project tempo behavior.
Time Signature, Time Signature display. Indicates the number of beats in a bar and the note value for one beat. Drag vertically to edit the value, or double-click and enter a new value.
Key Signature, Key Signature display. Indicates the key signature of the project. Choose a major or minor key signature from the pop-up menu.
Cycle   C, Cycle button. Use Cycle to repeatedly play, or record over, the project section within the yellow cycle area that appears in the ruler.
children.title: Cycle

children.help: Flashback Capture   ⇧R, Flashback Capture. Capture a recent MIDI or audio performance, even if Logic Pro wasn’t recording while you were playing.
children.title: Flashback Capture

children.help: Free Tempo Recording   ⌃⌥⌘R, Free Tempo Recording. Mutes all existing content during recording and performs a Smart Tempo analysis.
children.title: Free Tempo Recording

children.help: Record   R, Record button. Record to the selected track, or to multiple record-ready tracks.
children.title: Record

children.help: Play   ⌅, Play button. Start playback from the playhead position, or from the left locator shown in the ruler when in Cycle mode.
children.title: Play

children.help: Stop   0, Stop button. Stop playback or recording. Click when stopped to move the playhead to the project start point, or to the left locator shown in the ruler when in Cycle mode.
children.title: Stop

children.help: Replace   /, Replace button. Replace an existing recording, or a portion of it, with a new recording.
children.title: Replace

children.help: This control is unavailable because no audio track is selected., Tuner button. Tune instruments connected to your system.
children.title: Tuner

children.help: Solo, Solo button. Only hear selected regions during playback.
children.title: Solo

children.help: Count In   ⇧K, Count-in button. Play a predefined count-in before recording starts. Control-click the button to open a menu where you can choose the count-in length.
children.title: Count In

children.help: Metronome Click   K, Metronome button. Hear a click at the project tempo during playback or recording. Click and hold for further options.
children.title: Metronome Click

children.help: Library   Y, Library button. Load patches and presets for the selected channel strip or plug-in type; start playing immediately. Loading a patch can affect multiple channel strips.
children.title: Library

children.help: Inspector   I, Inspector button. View and edit region and track settings, based on where you’re working and the item selected. You can also set channel strip pan and volume, or add effects.
children.title: Inspector

children.help: Quick Help button. Show the Quick Help area. If the inspector is closed, Quick Help opens as a separate window.
children.title: Quick Help

children.help: Toolbar   ⌃⌥⌘T, Toolbar button. Show the toolbar, which contains buttons for key functions.
children.title: Toolbar

children.help: Smart Controls   B, Smart Controls button. Quickly modify the sound of the current patch without having to edit individual channel strips or plug-ins.
children.title: Smart Controls

children.help: Mixer   X, Mixer button. Open the Mixer, which shows channel strips for each track in the project. You can edit channel strip controls, add and edit plug-ins, and customize routing options.
children.title: Mixer

children.help: Editors   E, Editors button. Access editors—Audio Track, Audio File, Session Players, Piano Roll, Score, or Step Editor—based on the selected track type.
children.title: Editors

children.help: List Editors   D, List Editors button. View and edit MIDI events, markers, tempo changes, and signature events.
children.title: List Editors

children.help: Note Pads   ⌃⇧P, Note Pads button. Create, view, and edit project and track text notes.
children.title: Note Pads

children.help: Loop Browser   O, Loop Browser button. Add prerecorded loops to your project.
children.title: Loop Browser

children.help: Browsers   F, Browsers button. Access audio and other media files. You can also import data and settings from other projects.
children.title: Browsers

children.help: Control bar. Contains buttons and displays for key project and app functions. To customize, Control-click the control bar and choose Customize Control Bar and Display.
Library. Load and save patches, plug-in presets, or Sampler instruments, based on the selected channel strip slot. Loading a patch can affect multiple channel strips.
